text: Ive been waiting ages for someone to ring me back so trying this instead. My son is 7, temp 38.4 tonight. Hes had a runny blocked nose and sneezing all day which i thought was just a cold. But when i got him changed for bed theres these little dots on his legs and belly, tiny pin prick ones, some dark redish purple. I think I read you do the glass thing so i pressed a glass on them and they dont go away, you can still see them clear as anything through the glass. Not sure if im doing it right but i tried a few times. His neck is fine, he can put his chin down and look at his toes no problem, i checked cos i know thats a thing. I dont really know if this is serious or if im overreacting but honestly i would like someone to actually tell me instead of being left on hold for 40 mins
